product.title: Natural European White Oak Engineered Hardwood Flooring
product.body_html:
Transform your living space with authentic European White Oak planks.

  • 100% Waterproof seal with 72-hour standing water barrier
  • Click-Lock DIY installation without glue or nails
  • Scratch-resistant AC4 commercial grade protective finish
  • Ultra-matte wirebrushed texture reveals genuine wood grain
  • Covers 24.5 sq ft per carton
